{"id":549786808,"iid":4131,"project_id":34675721,"title":"docs: regenerate govern command docs after AI governance rename","description":"## Summary Ran `make gen-docs` to regenerate the four files flagged by the `check_docs_update` job. The generated docs were stale after MR !4130 changed "AI agent governance" to "AI governance" in the `govern` command help text. The regenerated output now matches that wording. The CI job was not re-run. The diff touches exactly the four files the job checks for. ## Files modified (all generated, none edited by hand) - `README.md` - `docs/source/govern/_index.md` - `docs/source/govern/doctor.md` - `docs/source/govern/setup.md` Fixes [failing pipeline](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/pipelines/2953343242)
